[Section] Methodology ::: GlossBERT ::: GlossBERT(Token-CLS)
[source_id=29] We use context-gloss pairs as input. We highlight the target word by taking the final hidden state of the token corresponding to the target word (if more than one token, we average them) and add a classification layer ($label\in \lbrace yes, no\rbrace $).
